item.title: Robbie Williams Breaks Beatles Chart Record By Waiting Out Taylor Swift Album Rollout
item.description: Robbie Williams now has the most UK #1 albums of all time. The former Take That member's latest, Britpop, debuted atop the UK album chart today, becoming his 16th #1. That surpasses the record of 15 set by the Beatles in 2000 with the release of their hits collection 1. According to The Guardian, Williams did it in 29 years, whereas the Beatles took 37 years to set the previous record. item.title: Pharrell Williams Sued By Former Neptunes Partner Chad Hugo
item.description: In 2024, Chad Hugo filed a legal action against his former Neptunes partner Pharrell Williams, accusing him of attempting to register trademarks for the Neptunes name without consulting Hugo. Now, Hugo is suing Pharrell, claiming he cut him out of their company and owes him up to $1 million from an N.E.R.D. album. The post Pharrell Williams Sued By Former Neptunes Partner Chad Hugo appeared first on Stereogum.

item.title: Yungblud Apologizes For Photo With Rammstein Frontman
item.description: Earlier this month, Yungblud went viral for speaking up for Iranian women's rights. The English rock musician is known for advocacy, and fans were recently disappointed to see a photo of him posing with Rammstein frontman Till Lindemann, who has sexual misconduct allegations.
